takeaways: Water and wastewater revenue increased by $2,258 thousand to $4,659 thousand.
Lot sales and single-family rental revenue were newly reported at $3,006 thousand and $231 thousand, respectively.
Water deliveries were newly reported at 631 acre-feet; tap counts were not mapped to tap-fee revenue because they are volume metrics.
data.summary: The quarter added new lot sales, rental revenue, and water-delivery drivers while updating water and wastewater revenue; reported earnings drivers were unchanged from the model.
